---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or a change to existing behavior
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**Problem**

What are you trying to do that SSAT doesn't currently support? Prefer describing the underlying problem over a specific implementation — there may already be a way to do this through an existing [extension point](../../docs/APPLICATION_API.md#extension-points) (custom adapter, source provider, or metric).

**Proposed change**

What you'd like to see added or changed. Note whether this fits one of the existing extension points (adapter/source/metric registry) or would need a new one (e.g. perturbation operators and report sections are not currently extensible through the public API — see the same section above).

**Alternatives considered**

Any workaround you're currently using, or other approaches you considered.
